title: Source: Netflix execs have been overriding the recommendation algorithm in recent months to push core movies and TV offerings over games and podcasts (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Source: Netflix execs have been overriding the recommendation algorithm in recent months to push core movies and TV offerings over games and podcasts — Company is overhauling creative leadership as it struggles to get domestic audiences to watch more — Netflix is writing a new script.
contentText:
Wall Street Journal :

Sources: Ted Sarandos complained for months of a lack of new Netflix hit shows and US watch time being down; Netflix just fired its film chief and content chief   —  Company is overhauling creative leadership as it struggles to get domestic audiences to watch more  —  Netflix is writing a new script.
